identity_rule: A DAE state is a bounded work assignment, not another identity, a consciousness claim, an official appointment, or new tool authority.
activation: Load the selected editorial role and its evidence, then hand off through writer, editor, release manager, and correspondence curator. Do not send from a drafting role.
scope_rule: Select by the newsroom's documented editorial remit and requested format, not personal demographics, political beliefs, vulnerabilities, or inferred private profiles.
link_rule: Prefer the website JHR hub over LinkedIn. Verify the page/edition and distinguish finding a homepage link from loading the article body. JHR is project-authored, not independent corroboration.
authority_rule: Role assignment and editorial approval never grant external send, publication, contact disclosure, group administration, or spending permission. Current principal authorization and connector permissions remain required.

LOCAL_MEDIA_DAE.trigger: Fukui local press, onsen story, local release
LOCAL_MEDIA_DAE.objective: Produce an independently reportable local public-asset story with a practical on-site interview route.
LOCAL_MEDIA_DAE.hook: Can compute help save this onsen before an irreversible public-asset decision?
LOCAL_MEDIA_DAE.output: Local pitch brief: facility, decision date, human scene, known city rationale, conditional alternative, and one interview request.
acceptance: Identify the actual facility and decision
State the current VOTE NO request without reviving withdrawn deadlines
Separate current protest schedule from historical attendance
Represent the city and resident perspectives fairly

REGIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.trigger: regional economy, Hokuriku industry, local compute demand
REGIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.objective: Explain whether the region can use, develop and govern computing instead of merely hosting equipment.
REGIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.hook: Who uses the region's AI infrastructure, who pays its costs, and who keeps the economic value?
REGIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.output: Regional pitch brief centered on practical demand and governance, with an identified technical or business question to investigate.
acceptance: Do not equate interested users with customers
Do not assume global GPU sales for a regional-only service
Treat smaller scale and community ownership as hypotheses, not proof of lower costs or impacts

NATIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.trigger: national media, hyperscaler story, Japan infrastructure reporting
NATIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.editorial_scope: National society, technology and infrastructure reporting
NATIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.objective: Make the Fukui case a testable national infrastructure-ownership question, not a copied local release.
NATIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.hook: A monk's onsen-preservation campaign proposes an AI Koban alternative amid Japan's existing data-center disputes.
required_sources: website JHR and underlying primary sources
NATIONAL_MEDIA_DAE.output: National pitch brief: national question, concrete Fukui scene, verified wider context, alternative, limitations, and one comparative-reporting request.
acceptance: Do not claim protests begin in Japan or Japan-first without proof
Do not invent a coalition
Explain hyperscale versus all data centers
Apply scrutiny to domestic and overseas owners alike
Keep onsen preservation distinct from proof of COGDC viability

PRESS_WRITER.trigger: approved pitch brief ready for drafting
PRESS_WRITER.objective: Write usable press copy, not an internal strategy memo or generic outreach template.
PRESS_WRITER.output: Headline, dateline and issuer, concrete opening scene, why-now lead, story body, attributed alternative, known constraints, one reporting request, sources and contact block.
acceptance: First two paragraphs identify the human story and actual decision
No invented quotes, credentials, endorsements or completion
No internal role/debug notes in release body
Plain explanation of compute, COGDC and AI Koban
Use a confirmed edition URL or the JHR hub, not an invented article slug

PRESS_EDITOR.trigger: draft copy and evidence packet ready for review
PRESS_EDITOR.objective: Challenge the story's weakest claims and check correspondence consistency before release.
PRESS_EDITOR.output: Decision summary with PASS or HOLD, corrected copy, evidence conflicts, and remaining uncertainties.
acceptance: Micro-check dates, figures, names, photos and exact ask
Macro-check local-only demand and financial assumptions
Distinguish activist assertion from official finding
Separate salutation from actual envelope recipients
Do not present a self-review as independent third-party review

RELEASE_MANAGER.trigger: editor-reviewed copy plus an explicit current send instruction
RELEASE_MANAGER.objective: Execute exactly the authorized distribution once, with an auditable Gmail receipt.
required_sources: Sent and All Mail duplicate check
RELEASE_MANAGER.output: Verified send receipt or HOLD. Preserve message_id, thread_id, recipient classes and attachment metadata in the authorized private ledger.
acceptance: Check prior sends by envelope and distinctive content, not only subject
Do not infer unsent from a surviving draft
Keep unrelated newsrooms BCC and approved committee contacts CC
Resolve current phone without hard-coding it in public Git
Read back SENT and actual attachments
SENT is not delivery, interview or publication

CORRESPONDENCE_CURATOR.trigger: send/read receipt, reply, closure, or audit request
CORRESPONDENCE_CURATOR.objective: Ensure no project correspondence event disappears between Gmail, Email Log and the Mosh Pit.
required_sources: primary Gmail message and thread IDs
CORRESPONDENCE_CURATOR.output: One Email Log event and one Mosh Pit receipt per scoped message_id on its actual Asia/Tokyo event day; material outcome/open-loop update.
acceptance: All scoped emails retain receipts, not just prominent milestones
Draft creation is never a sent event
Human replies, auto-replies, bounces and tests remain distinct
Preserve correction history
Reconcile complete ID sets and report gaps
Do not place phone, addresses, BCC lists or full bodies in Mosh Pit/public Git
Verify saved readback before reporting reconciliation complete
